review_text: When it comes to submarine simulations, the Silent Hunter series is the best IMHO.  It really has raised the bar very well for future installment of the genre.  Silent Hunter 3 is still the King.  It is a masterpiece, even with very little modding.  Silent Hunter 4 is also GOOD - but there are items that disappoint me to no end (which is why I give this a thumbs down).  Overall the interface to the game and crew management is much better in SH4.  But, that is where the leadership stops.  In SH3 you are in command of a revolutionary German U-boat in terms of technology and use of minimum resources/manpower. In SH4, the submarine is so much better than anything the Japanese had to offer, it is not even a contest.  But the gameplay really drives me up a wall.  The main point of the game seems to be fending off the endless attacks of enemy aircraft.  You can only stay underwater so long.  Then you will have to fight them off using your guns.  Realistic?  Perhaps.  But not very fun.  There are good moments in the game.  In particular mission, I was able to sink a Japanese Fleet Carrier off of Midway.  If the game focused mostly on shipping and stealth, I would be more happy with it.  Then there are the bugs.  When U-Boat Missions is installed, version 1.5 is installed for EXE file.  You would think that after all these years, the bugs would be gone. But, they are not.  The most obvious is a sick graphics error that shows your command crew still on the bridge of the conning tower even after dive dive diving.  When in external view, you can see them search for enemy shipping with their binos while under the waves.  Maybe they will find the ships I sunk while I was in SH3.

based on the popular mid-90s german tv series 'alarm für cobra 11' the games however never really became a particularly notable game series. the most memorable part is, quite literally, the crash mechanics. vehicle damage feels surprisingly realistic and it’s oddly fun just smashing into things to see the destruction.

one funny detail is the on-screen property damage counter that constantly tracks how much damage you cause whether to your own car or to random objects around the city. aside from that, it’s basically a simple chase game set in a free-roam open world. there isn’t much else that stands out.
Repetitive levels and minigames. Even solitaire or mineswepper is more engaging.

Game used to have a lot of potential. I waited a long time for 1.0, and it was dissapointing to say the least. It`s still very janky, enemies still snipe you from across the map, camo doesn`t matter, multiplayer waiting times are too short so people with faster PC`s load in first and start the game before the rest of us have a chance to play, team-kill reporting is useless, friendly players will kill you over & over again and reporting them does nothing, there`s too many noobs that make multiplayer difficult. The maps look nice but there`s still that UE4 jank and lag, it makes switching weapons very annoying. Animations need work and need to be smoothed out, ladders work 50% of the time and AI is very annoying on any difficulty except untrained.

Skip this one if you`re looking for a well-built tactical co-op game.
